pages.text: You might want more mounds, either to obtain more resources or obtain new Mounds capable of placing a Structure Block. There are two ways to achieve this:$(br2)The first one is to let a chest with at least one food item (such as a piece of Biomass) not too far from a Mound. Stage 3 and 4 Mounds will eventually detect it and grow a Mound on this chest, feeding on the food at their disposal.

The second way is to wait for Scampers, though this is not a solution that will allow you to obtain Structure Blocks. Scampers are strange looking Spore creatures, which you can recognize easily as they look weird and walk veeeeery slowly. Stage 4 Mounds spawn them every 10 minutes. If a Scamper exists for more than 10 minutes, it will evolve into a Gastgeber, which is basically a bunch of Mounds with legs.
